question:
The Witch of Sloth is decent compared to Pete-san, huh.
Wait? What does 'decent' even mean again?
answer:
Sekhmet-san has the highest common sense among the Witches.
When compared by common sense:
Sekhmet > Carmilla > Daphne > Echidna > Minerva > Typhon
is the order.
This time, the bottom two were splendidly selected!
As for Satella, she doesn't even qualify for comparison in this common sense certification to begin with.
Because that word doesn't exist in her dictionary.
